intro:
Creative, collaborative Front End Engineer from the Peaks, with {{experience}} years' experience spanning agency, in-house and freelance roles - including Next, Node, React (+ Native) and TypeScript.

I care about accessibility and love using subtle animation and interactivity to craft natural user experiences. Away from the keyboard, I like to go mountain biking or scuba diving.

skills:
My huge wealth of experience in engineering has equipped me with a broad toolkit across web and native technologies, and a genuine focus on code that's tested, scalable, performant and accessible. Next, Node, React Native and TypeScript are my usual stack; but I prefer reaching for the right tool over the familiar one, and keep pace with the evolving ecosystem.

I'm a T-shaped engineer who values working closely with other disciplines. Mentoring is where I do some of my best work - there's nothing more satisfying than watching someone I've mentored get promoted - though I'm equally at home solving a hard technical problem myself.
